nodes.description: Public mapping (address => Wallet[]) holding all wallets, their owners, allowances, logs and transactions; the primary storage attacked by reentrancy in executeTxn.
Modifier looping over wallets[creator][walletId].owners and comparing each entry against msg.sender; grants access when a match is found.
Empty constructor of the multisig contract.
View getter scanning wallets[creator] for a matching name.
View getter returning the owners array of a wallet.
View getter returning number of transactions of a wallet after a length check.
View getter returning full transaction data for a wallet.
View getter returning number of log entries of a wallet.
View getter returning a single log entry's sender and amount.
Payable function that validates name/approvals, rejects duplicates and instantiates a new Wallet owned by msg.sender.
Payable function that increases wallets[creator][id].allowance by msg.value and appends a Log entry.
Owner-only function that appends a new Transaction to the wallet and stores destination, value and data.
Owner-only function that pushes msg.sender into txn.confirmed and marks the transaction Pending once approvals are reached.
Owner-only function that checks Pending status and allowance, performs the external call, then updates status and allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, wallet indexing, transaction creators and confirmation bookkeeping.
assert(dest.call.value(val)(dat)) forwards arbitrary value and calldata to an attacker-influenced destination before any state is finalized.
Number of required approvals supplied to createWallet.
Array of owner addresses supplied to createWallet.
Wallet name supplied to createWallet, used for duplicate detection.
Destination address supplied to submitTransaction and later used in the low-level call.
Amount supplied to submitTransaction and later paid out during execution.
Wallet creator address used as mapping key in topBalance.
Wallet index used to locate the wallet in topBalance.
Local copy of txn.value forwarded as msg.value in the low-level call.
Local copy of txn.destination used as the target of the low-level call.
Storage pointer to the transaction being executed; its status and value are mutated after the external call.
Storage pointer to the wallet being debited; its allowance is decremented after the external call.

edges.reason: approvals parameter is validated (approvals <= owners.length) and stored as appovalsreq.
owners array parameter is copied into the new wallet's owners list.
name parameter is length-checked, compared against existing wallets and stored.
destination parameter is stored on the new Transaction.
value parameter is stored on the new Transaction.
creator parameter selects the wallets mapping entry being topped up.
id parameter selects the wallet inside wallets[creator].
Modifier authorization depends entirely on msg.sender matching an entry of the owners array.
onlyOwner compares each stored owner with the caller; failure silently skips the function body instead of reverting.
submitTransaction is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
confirmTransaction is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
executeTxn is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is used as the wallets mapping key, so every caller can only create wallets under their own address (implicit access control).
msg.sender is recorded as the log entry sender after topping up a wallet.
msg.sender is stored as transaction creator and must pass the onlyOwner check.
msg.sender is pushed into txn.confirmed and used in the duplicate-confirmation loop.
msg.sender must be an owner of the wallet for executeTxn to run.
executeTxn invokes the unprotected low-level call while the transaction is still marked Pending.
The external call returns control to executeTxn before txn.status and wallet.allowance are updated, allowing re-entrant execution.
Caller-influenced txn.value (copied to val) is forwarded as msg.value in the external call.
Caller-influenced txn.destination (copied to dest) is the recipient/callee of the external call.
txn.status is written to Executed only after the external call, so a re-entrant call still sees Pending.
wallet.allowance = wallet.allowance - txn.value uses unchecked Solidity 0.4.21 subtraction with no SafeMath.
txn.value is copied into the local val before the external call.
msg.sender is used directly as the outer key of the public wallets mapping, letting any caller create state under its own address.
createWallet reads and extends wallets[msg.sender] when instantiating a new wallet.

normalization_plan.reason: approvals parameter only participates in the require check and storage write inside createWallet.
owners array is directly assigned to wallets[msg.sender][currentLen].owners inside createWallet.
name is length-checked, compared and stored entirely within createWallet.
destination is written straight into the new Transaction inside submitTransaction.
value is written straight into the new Transaction inside submitTransaction.
creator is only used as the wallets mapping key inside topBalance.
id only indexes wallets[creator] inside topBalance.
val is a direct copy of txn.value and is consumed by the low-level call.
dest is a direct copy of txn.destination and is the target of the low-level call.
txn is the storage pointer whose status/value drive executeTxn and is mutated after the external call.
wallet is the storage pointer whose allowance is read and decremented by executeTxn.
